meta.title: Op-ed check: US handover spending, NED lawsuit, EU layer
oped_flags: Op-ed calls the judge 'Krystyna' Korwin-Piotrowska; every source says Anna.
Op-ed calls Patyra 'Stanisław'; his name is Sławomir.
'the group Tusk led as party president': Tusk led the EPP party (2019-22), not the EP group (led by Weber).
'Soros's Polish foundation': Batory was founded by Soros in 1988 and lists OSF as a donor, but is an independent Polish foundation; 'Soros-founded' is accurate.
'Civic Coalition MEP': elected on the KO list but non-party; EP profile says 'Independent'.
'Free Courts has published no statement': we only know its website news stops in 2024; say 'none found on its website'.
'precise plan' quote comes from TVP's page summary only; full interview not retrieved.

'An American-funded fellow co-founded a group that took Soros money': he co-founded Free Courts in 2017, years before the NED fellowship (2022/23) and the OSF grant (2023-24); the wording implies a sequence that did not happen.
'Two other new judges advised Soros's Polish foundation': they co-signed a Batory expert-team position; 'advised' is fair, payment undisclosed.
US 'They said it out loud' section: all real quotes, but none is tied to Poland in any source; the graph marks the Poland link no_link.
